name: hermes-agent-runner
description: Run Hermes Agent as a bounded external runtime with Ouroboros session state, provenance, and handoff artifacts.

commands.name: run
commands.summary: Run a bounded non-interactive Hermes task under Ouroboros supervision.

commands.name: chat
commands.summary: Prepare an auditable Hermes interactive attach session.

commands.name: resume
commands.summary: Show resume information for a Hermes-backed Ouroboros session.

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: Mark a Hermes session stopped/cancelled under Ouroboros state.

commands.name: export
commands.summary: Export Hermes session state and transcripts into a handoff directory.

capabilities.name: runtime
capabilities.reason: Launch bounded Hermes subprocesses or attach sessions.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record runtime decisions, permission usage, and completion state.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record invocation metadata, transcripts, and artifact paths.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach final or partial Hermes outputs to downstream Ouroboros workflows.

permissions.reason: Launch Hermes as an external runtime under a bounded subprocess/session.
Read workspace context and saved session state.
Write transcripts, session state, and handoff artifacts.
Hermes model providers or web tools may need network reads when explicitly trusted.
Hermes messaging gateways may perform external delivery only when explicitly trusted.
